what_this_is: The CURRENT deployment pins, in two blocks that are two different facts. `live` is what production serves: the deployment record's own numbers, moved ONLY by a deployment-authorization order. `source` is what a FRESH assembly of the committed source produces: moved by an application order, which puts source AHEAD of production until the next deploy. When the two agree, ahead_of_production is false and moved_by is null. Consumed historical authorizations are never restated here; they live in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations and are immutable evidence of what was authorized at the time (see supersessions.json).

live.note: Fayetteville, North Carolina joined as the NINETEENTH market at 26 published profiles, registered from zero as COMPOSITE_FRESH_MARKET_DATA_ONLY and founder-authorized on 2026-09-13. The host refused the first two production deploys (HTTP 403, account usage); after the account was restored the exact authorized artifact was deployed with no rebuild. The live sitemap hashes to the authorized candidate and all 1438 live routes return 200. Rollback is the deployment Fayetteville replaced (Asheville-live, 18 markets), not that deployment's own rollback target.

source.note: A fresh assembly of the committed source produces exactly what production serves: the same bundle digest, from the same committed authority.
